name: Agent Ready Kit
tagline: Audit any repo for AI coding-agent readiness.
problem: Most repos do not tell AI agents how to set up, test, change, or safely contribute.
useCase: Run it before using Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, or another coding agent on a repo.

name: Context Scout AI
tagline: Generate compact, ranked repo briefs for AI coding agents.
problem: AI coding agents waste time and tokens when developers paste messy repo context.
useCase: Run one command before asking an agent to understand, debug, or change a codebase.

name: Agent Diff Sentinel
tagline: Review git diffs for AI-agent risk before a PR lands.
problem: AI-assisted PRs can touch auth, billing, secrets, dependencies, and tests faster than reviewers can triage the risky parts.
useCase: Run it on an agent-written diff before merge to get a focused review report and blocker signal.
